svg.title: HotRC CT-6A Mini Hunter control mapping
svg.desc: The steering wheel is channel 1 and changes Turn. The trigger is channel 2 and changes Trig. Mini Hunter OLED examples show neutral, throttle, and turning values.
svg.text: Example bundled controller. It uses different receiver channels from the HT-10A.
What the robot OLED should show
Values change live while RC Mode is open.
The sign can reverse with transmitter settings.
The important check: centered = 0; movement = change.
